findings.description: Konrad Grubenmann was buried on 17 March 1787 in Teufen, Appenzell Ausserrhoden, Switzerland; the burial entry indexes him as Conrad Grubenmann, born 1699, with Anna Reff as his wife.
supporting_sources: Schweiz, Katholische und Reformiert Kirchenbücher, 1418-1996 — burial entry for Conrad Grubenmann and Anna Reff, 17 Mar 1787
